item.title: 'If you’re looking for a cheap mechanical keyboard, you can’t do much better': I tested a budget clacker that's impressive for gaming or home working — but its cutbacks are evident
item.description: How well does this retro-looking mechanical keyboard perform by modern standards?

item.title: ‘Makes up for its predecessor’s fumbles, rather than actually keeping pace with competitors’ — I like this Epson projector’s Google TV OS and boosted HDMI ports but these quality of life upgrades are too little too late
item.description: The LifeStudio Grand is a refresh of Epson’s earlier LS650 projector, and while it has some good-to-see improvements, it’s not a major upgrade.

item.title: The MacBook Neo may no longer be 'affordable', but a small discount sees it drop to a three-figure price
item.description: Initially launching at a rock-bottom AU$899 price earlier this year, the MacBook Neo isn’t quite the budget darling anymore after a sizeable price hike — but for AU$997, this deal is hard to pass up.
